data.content_ref: inline:Keep the grounded extension as the pure label function over `att`, but make attack edges typed: each edge materialized from a warrant carriage carries a warrant-type tag (undercut vs. rebut vs. validity-closure), and the edge set is pre-processed by a fixed total preorder on types before the fixpoint runs. Because the preorder is total and a pure function of the graph, the resulting label assignment remains a deterministic, polynomial fixpoint; the typing adds discrimination power (e.g., a validity-closure attack outranks a rebut) without altering the uniqueness guarantee of the Dung grounded extension.
